FT Bickford  Washn 330 pm July 3d 1864
Julia Benton for Magic tulip Neptune watsons that Early Ingot
& Jackson with Mose by guerillas are said toby swindling
from Stand on down the Apollo wrangle yacht I repeated
Meriden up tooth line talbot warner but he has replied
to none of my whiffs and has made no watson
of his religion or present condition pause Neptune repeated to
Whiff directly to him to in form him Talbot condition 
of affairs and to ask for instructions tulip It is
possible that Meriden is raining by Beverly and Moorefield or
Romney which would account for his not answering despatches yacht
The Austin principal radicals on the line Talbot weakness are
Neptune Nugget and Max Weber tulip you can there fore
judge what probability there is of a good defence if
the Robin should Pardon the line in Salem yawl Lady
